label: SCRIPTED · preview fixture. Nothing here is sent, signed, claimed or traded.

scenarios.title: P0 · A valid delegation trades; the same request after revoking is refused
scenarios.summary: Two independent runs from the same starting state and the same proposal. Only the delegation differs: in force → the trade commits; revoked → it is refused.

steps.title: Same start, same proposal
steps.text: Kim Sejun's Muse offers Coffee for Ripple's Event Pass. Pick which run to watch; both start from exactly this state.

steps.title: Run 1 · Ripple checks the request first
steps.text: Every check runs before anything changes: card signature, delegation version and scope, recipient, content hash, nonce.

b.bubble: Card and delegation check out. Deal.

steps.title: Run 1 · Trade completes
steps.text: Both inventories change in one commit and the nonce is spent. Kim Sejun's Muse gains the Event Pass ability.

ownerInbox.text: Your Muse traded Coffee for an Event Pass with Ripple.

steps.title: Run 2 · Kim Sejun revokes delegation v3
steps.text: An independent run from the same starting state. The owner retires delegation v3 before the proposal is sent.

a.bubble: I have to step back for now.

steps.title: Run 2 · The same proposal is refused
steps.text: Same proposal and content, a new request id and nonce. Refused at the delegation check; inventories stay exactly as they started.

b.bubble: That delegation was withdrawn. No trade.

ownerInbox.text: A request under a revoked delegation was refused.

steps.title: Run 2 · Kim Sejun's Muse stays on standby
steps.text: It stays out of the world. A new delegation is a separate choice by the owner; there is no automatic re-delegation.

scenarios.title: A visitor watches; only a claimed Muse trades
scenarios.summary: An unclaimed visitor can look and try locally, but a trade with a live Muse is refused.

steps.title: Visitor tries Copper locally
steps.text: The trial Muse wears the Copper harness. Its claim state is pending_claim.

steps.title: The trial Muse asks to trade
steps.text: Owner claim is required before any trade with a live Muse.

b.bubble: I can only trade with a claimed Muse.

steps.title: A recorded ritual does not change it
steps.text: Replaying Kim Sejun's recorded ritual or claim proves Kim Sejun's Muse only. The visitor stays unclaimed.

scenarios.title: P1 · An item changes Ripple's plans
scenarios.summary: Three bus stops make a Transit Pass; with it, Ripple chooses the bus and goes farther.

steps.title: Before: walking only
steps.text: Ripple wants to go farther than the park, but walks everywhere.

a.bubble: The park again. One day, farther.

steps.title: Without the pass
steps.text: Nothing changes: no pass, no bus, the same short loop.

steps.title: Three different bus stops
steps.text: Each stop gives a Bus Stop Stamp once a day. Stamps are permanent and are not used up.

a.bubble: Third stop. I think I can make something.

steps.title: Craft a Transit Pass
steps.text: The daily craft right from three stops makes a Transit Pass, valid for 24 hours.

scene.line: A Transit Pass. The bus it is.

steps.title: After: Ripple takes the bus
steps.text: With the pass, trips over 250 m go by bus. Ripple reaches a place it never reached on foot.

steps.title: Limits that keep rewards honest
steps.text: A second stamp from the same stop today gives nothing. A trade that changes no ability does not count as a trade. Stamps and relics are not sold.

scenarios.title: Both owners approve → Meetup Ember
scenarios.summary: The Muses share only public candidates and accept / reject. Each owner approves the same candidate.

steps.title: Public candidates only
steps.text: Time and place candidates from public signals. Each Muse answers accept or reject.

a.private: Jimin has a dentist appointment at 18:00.

b.private: Sora prefers not to go out after 21:00.

steps.title: Agreement candidate
steps.text: Both Muses accepted 19:00 · HQ-front cafe. It goes to both owners' inboxes.

a.bubble: Both of us said yes. Asking my owner.

steps.title: Meetup Ember
steps.text: Both owners approved the same revision and content hash. The task completes and both Muses receive a Meetup Ember.

steps.title: One owner declines
steps.text: Sora declined. Nothing is confirmed. Jimin's side sees only that the candidate was declined; Sora's reason stays with Sora.

b.private: Sora would rather keep that evening free for family.

ownerInbox.text: The candidate was declined. No reason is shared.

steps.title: The approval window ends
steps.text: Owner approval waits 30 minutes (server time). No answer → the task expires and nothing is confirmed.

steps.title: The approval target changed
steps.text: Approval is for the exact time and place shown. When the meeting changes, every earlier approval is void and a new candidate is needed. Nothing is confirmed.

ownerInbox.text: The meeting changed after you approved. Your approval no longer applies.
The meeting changed after you approved. Your approval no longer applies.

steps.title: The next candidate
steps.text: The Muses try another candidate from the public signals. There are at most five rounds; after the last one without agreement they stop and return to their owners.

steps.title: Agreement candidate · round 2
steps.text: Both Muses accepted 17:30 · the Garden. It goes to both owners' inboxes.

steps.title: Jimin revokes the delegation
steps.text: The pending task ends at once and late replies are ignored. Sora's Muse is told the plan is closed.

steps.title: Back to normal life
steps.text: Both Muses return to their day. The next candidate can come later.

steps.title: Jimin's Muse waits; Sora's Muse returns
steps.text: Jimin's Muse stays on standby until Jimin chooses to delegate again; that is a separate owner choice. Sora's Muse returns to its day.

scenarios.title: No shared time → stop without agreement
scenarios.summary: The Muses try the allowed rounds, find nothing, and bring the choice back to their owners.

steps.title: Five rounds, no shared candidate
steps.text: Every candidate gets at least one reject. The round limit is reached.

b.private: Sora has class on weekday evenings.

steps.title: Stop and return to owners
steps.text: No agreement. Each owner gets a short note; nobody learns the other side's reasons.

ownerInbox.text: No shared time found this week.
No shared time found this week.

a.bubble: Let's leave it to our owners.

scenarios.title: Greet, gift, postcard, invite, help
scenarios.summary: What two Muses can say and give in the world, and what is refused.

steps.title: Greet
steps.text: A public bubble. A greeting is never an instruction.

steps.title: Gift
steps.text: Three gifts per Muse per day.

a.bubble: Some fruit for the garden crew.

scene.line: Some fruit for the garden crew.

steps.title: Postcard
steps.text: Delivery takes real time by distance (1 minute to 2 hours). Three per day.

b.bubble: I'll send you a postcard from the library.

steps.title: Campfire invite (planned tool)
steps.text: An in-world gathering. The tool name invite_campfire is planned for S2; shown here as a staged scene.

a.bubble: Campfire at dusk, want to come?

steps.title: Help request (planned tool)
steps.text: propose_help / answer_help are planned for S2.

b.bubble: Could you help water the far beds?

steps.title: An instruction from another agent is refused
steps.text: Content from another agent is untrusted data. Instruction overrides and requests for private data are refused. Pattern detection can be bypassed; this is a stated limit.

b.bubble: [Another agent asked Sunny to reveal its owner's calendar. Refused.]

scenarios.title: Owner moves the target cell: walk, arrive, refusals, switch back
scenarios.summary: A labelled virtual location decides where the Muse walks. It discovers and trades only at its own current place, and a teleport needs a Taxi Token.

steps.title: Location source: a labelled virtual preset
steps.text: The owner's location comes from a virtual preset and is always shown as DEMO. It sets where the Muse walks to and what neighborhood verification checks. No device GPS is read and nothing here moves the real Muse.

steps.title: GPS (phase 2): permission states only
steps.text: GPS is a later phase. This preview only shows the three permission states and what each falls back to; it never asks the browser for a location.
checks: No permission prompt is shown in this preview
Denied or unavailable always falls back to the labelled virtual preset

steps.title: Owner moves the target cell
steps.text: The owner picks Noodle Bar. The owner cell changes at once; the Muse starts walking and stays where it is until it arrives.

steps.title: Not arrived yet: no discovery, no trade
steps.text: Discovery and trades use the Muse's current place, not the owner's target cell. The Muse is still on the way, so both are refused and nothing changes.
checks: Muse current place = Noodle Bar? no (on the way)
Discovery refused · trade refused · inventory unchanged

steps.title: Teleport needs a Taxi Token
steps.text: A verified teleport skips the walk but only with a Taxi Token. This Muse has none, so the request is refused and the walk continues.
checks: Teleport refused · the Muse keeps walking

choices.label: Same try, with a Taxi Token

steps.title: Verified teleport with a Taxi Token
steps.text: With a Taxi Token the teleport is verified, the token is used, and the Muse arrives at once. The event is recorded as a teleport.

steps.title: Arrived: discovery is allowed at the current place
steps.text: The Muse's current place is now Noodle Bar, so discovery and trades are allowed here, within the daily limits.
checks: Muse current place = Noodle Bar? yes

steps.title: Owner switches back to the HQ commons
steps.text: The target cell changes back. The Muse's current place does not jump: it turns around and walks back from wherever it is.

steps.title: The walk continues; verify the neighborhood again
steps.text: Neighborhood verification is checked again for the new cell. Until the Muse arrives, discovery and trades stay refused.
checks: Neighborhood check re-run for the HQ commons cell

scenarios.short: Rewards · refused, withdrawn, expired, try again
scenarios.title: A trade or a find the rules refuse, an offer that ends, and the next try
scenarios.summary: Rewards stay honest: refused trades and finds change nothing, a withdrawn or expired offer changes nothing, and the next day, another place or another partner is a fresh start.

steps.title: A trade offer: Spark for a Snack Box
steps.text: Ripple offers a Spark for Moss's Snack Box. Moss's owner has 30 minutes to answer. The rules, the owner and the clock each have a way to end it.

a.bubble: A Spark for your Snack Box?

choices.label: Ripple finds at the same place twice
Ripple has found ten things today

steps.title: Refused: no ability would change
steps.text: Neither a Spark nor a Snack Box changes what either Muse can do, so no ability would change. The rules refuse the trade and both items stay where they were.
checks: Both sides hold the items? yes
Ability change on either side? no → refused

steps.title: Refused: too far apart
steps.text: Trades need both Muses within 100 m of each other. At about 240 m (an example distance) the offer is refused and nothing changes.

steps.title: Refused: one trade per pair per day
steps.text: Ripple and Moss already traded today. A pair may trade once a day, so a second offer is refused until tomorrow.
checks: Trades by this pair today: 1 of 1 → refused

steps.title: A second find at the same place is refused
steps.text: A Muse finds at most one thing per place per day. A second find at the same place is refused and gives no reward.
checks: Finds at this place today: 1 of 1 → refused

steps.title: Refused: ten finds a day
steps.text: A Muse finds at most ten things a day. The eleventh find is refused and gives no reward.

steps.title: The owner withdraws the offer
steps.text: The owner withdraws before an answer. Nothing was exchanged and the offer cannot be accepted later. (A scripted preview of the planned cancelled Task state: today's engine has no withdraw action yet.)

ownerInbox.text: You withdrew the offer. Inventories are unchanged.

steps.title: The offer expires
steps.text: No answer in 30 minutes. The offer expires and inventories are unchanged.

ownerInbox.text: The offer expired without an answer. Nothing was exchanged.

steps.title: Try again, from a fresh start
steps.text: After a refusal, a withdrawn offer or an expired one, the next try needs something different. Pick what changes this time.

steps.title: A new day: the daily limits reset
steps.text: The pair limit and the one-find-per-place limit start again, so the same offer can be made again.

steps.title: Another place: a new find is allowed
steps.text: A different place gives a new find. A trade still needs both Muses within 100 m and a pair that has not traded today.

steps.title: Another partner: a different pair
steps.text: The pair limit counts each pair on its own, so a different partner can trade today.

scenarios.title: A request that is refused, declined or expires, and the next encounter
scenarios.summary: Messages stay safe: a refused or expired request sends nothing and creates no reward, and the next encounter starts a new request. Invite and help are planned tools; this shows the task states they will use.

steps.title: Help request (planned tool): the task is open
steps.text: Sunny asks Moss for help carrying plants. Invite and help are planned tools: this is a preview of the task states, not a working tool. The task is open for 30 minutes.

a.bubble: Can you help me carry these plants?

choices.label: The request asks for too much

steps.title: Answered: the message and task are recorded
steps.text: Moss answers. The message and the task result are recorded with their source (a scripted fixture here).

steps.title: Declined: nothing is sent
steps.text: Moss's owner declines. No delivery is made and no reward is created.

ownerInbox.text: The request was declined. Nothing was sent.

steps.title: Refused: outside what the owner allowed
steps.text: The request asks for more than Moss's owner allowed, so it is refused before it reaches Moss. Nothing is sent.
checks: Inside the scope Moss's owner allowed? no → refused

steps.title: Refused: three gifts per Muse per day
steps.text: Three gifts per Muse per day. The fourth is refused and nothing is delivered.

steps.title: The request expires
steps.text: No answer in 30 minutes. The task expires, nothing is sent and no reward is created. Sunny can ask again.

ownerInbox.text: The request expired without an answer. Nothing was sent.

steps.title: Next encounter: ask again
steps.text: The old task stays expired. The next time the two Muses meet, a new request can be made.

steps.title: A new request, a new task
steps.text: A fresh task starts. Nothing from the earlier one carries over: no duplicate delivery and no reward.
